title: Branch gate checks GMCP evidence currency when a branch touches GMCP
goal: Core PR checks never ran tests/gmcp_requirements.rs, so a branch that changed crates/susi-gmcp without re-recording VC-203 evidence merged green and staled main (#1561, #1618 on 2026-11-04); the tagged suites of v0.21.48 and v0.21.49 then failed gmcp mastery and neither release published. Add a step to the required 'Compile Check (branch pushes)' job that runs the full gmcp_requirements target when the branch's diff from its merge-base with origin/main touches crates/susi-gmcp/, .agents/gmcp/ or tests/gmcp_requirements.rs (and when the base cannot be resolved), and skips in seconds otherwise; pin it in xtask/tests/ci_workflow_perf.rs.
